key_insight: RDS-MOPD allocates multi-teacher distillation effort toward domains regressing from their own best performance, while resisting noisy signals and isolated anomalies.
engineering_relevance: The approach helps allocate a limited training budget across math, coding, and instruction-following teachers when building a compact student model.
method: Use distributionally robust optimization to prioritize the worst-regressing domain.
Shift domain allocation only when signal differences clearly exceed noise.
Bound individual anomalies’ influence and measure regression against each domain’s own best level.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports outperforming recent competing methods and ranking first on most math, code-generation, and instruction-following benchmarks, but provides no numerical results.
watch_item: Practical performance may depend on reliably estimating noise and tracking each domain’s best level from sparse rollouts.
paper_title: Robust Domain-Mixture Scheduling for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
